name: exa-2
description: exa — modern replacement for ls command. Colorized, tree view, git integration, human-readable sizes.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/ogham/exa/releases/latest/download/exa-linux-x86_64.zip && unzip -o exa-linux-x86_64.zip && sudo mv exa /usr/local/bin/ && rm exa-linux-x86_64.zip
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
